title: epipactis helleborine subsp. condensata
intro: Epipactis helleborine subsp. condensata, commonly known as the Helleborine orchid or Condensed Helleborine, is a rare subspecies of orchid native to Europe. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable resource for treating various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis helleborine subsp. condensata include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antiseptic effects, which can help to reduce swelling, fight infections, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to have potential in treating conditions such as arthritis and respiratory infections.
